assumptions.name: Twisted Slavnov scalar-product identity
assumptions.authorized_by: User: We can assume Slavnov’s identity, add it to the assumed list.
assumptions.scope: Finite twisted on-shell/off-shell scalar-product determinant, with the normalization of Section 2. No Gaudin norm, deleted-column identity, inverse bound or thermodynamic assertion is added to this assumption.
assumptions.implementation: Explicit proposition argument to conditional theorems; no global Lean axiom.
assumptions.proof_obligation: Prove the finite twisted Slavnov derivative-over-Cauchy identity from the ABA relations. The exact source normalization, complex root limits, Gaudin norm, deleted columns and weights have been proved in Lean conditional on this one hypothesis.
